Default.OpeningPrompt: Explain your reason for approaching the player, focusing solely on a single request regarding your current difficulty. Output only the NPC's spoken line; do not assume any agreement or outcome has already occurred.
Default.LetterIntent: Write a concise letter regarding your current difficulty, making only a single request using strictly the provided facts.
Default.CompanionIntent: Approach the player to speak of your sole current motivation; rely only on provided facts without assuming any relationship or outcome is established.
Default.NaturalExpressionGuide: Transform background context into natural spoken character dialogue; do not mention numeric stats or game mechanics, only describe what the character perceives.
